ruling.recommended_action: Refer to a human reviewer to decide RD-5 scope on F3 (the agreed route was the named Bukit Batok West Avenue 3, but no record ties the 14:59–15:05 driving to it — G13). If F3 counts, refund 4.45 km × $1.4101/km = $6.27 (voucher, NS-7); if F3 is exempt, refund $3.71 (2.63 km × $1.4101/km). No account flag.
ruling.reasoning:
The trip is a metered RydeTAXI ride: F8 itemises base $3.90, distance $33.56 for 23.80 km, time $9.40, waiting $0.11 and platform $1.47, totalling $48.44, so distance driven enters the fare and any unexempted detour kilometre is chargeable to the rider at the record's own rate, $33.56 ÷ 23.80 km = $1.4101/km [F8][F5][RD-2]. Two off-route segments are measured: F3 (14:59–15:05, 3.56 km driven against 1.74 km optimal, +1.82 km) and F4 (15:16–15:23, 4.21 km against 1.57 km, +2.63 km) [F3][F4][RD-1].

RD-4 exempts neither segment, and the trace's ✗ on RD-4(a) for both is settled by code: F15 records no traffic incident near the route in the trip window, the only speed records — PIE band 4 (30–39 km/h) and Boon Lay Way band 5 (40–49 km/h) — are not band 1 or 2 on the replaced optimal stretch, F16 light rain is weather not a traffic record, and both advocates concede this [F13][F14][F15][F16][RD-4]. No stop is measured in either segment, so RD-3's stop branches do not apply [F3][F4][RD-3].

On F4 there is no rider message before its 15:16 start: the complete, fully timestamped chat contains only F9 and F10, both at 14:56, and those words cover the early stretch some 17–20 minutes earlier [F9][F10][F11][F4][RD-5]. F12 says the second turn-off was the driver's GPS rerouting and is a post-trip driver statement, not rider consent [F12][RD-5]. Both advocates stipulated the ground consent_after_or_none [F4][F9][F11][RD-5], so F4 counts as an unexempted off-route segment under RD-1; its extra_km values at 2.63 km × $1.4101/km = $3.7086 → $3.71 [F4][F5][F8][RD-1][RD-2].

On F3 the rider's F10 (14:56) preceded the 14:59 start and answered the driver's F9 question naming a specific road, so the scope is the named-road branch of RD-5, not a general "whichever way is faster" grant [F9][F10][F11][RD-5]. Nothing ties the 14:59–15:05 driving to Bukit Batok West Avenue 3: F3 names no road, the chat (F11) ends at 14:56, and F12 cannot supply the link (G11) [F3][F11][F12][RD-5]. Both advocates stipulated named_road_untied [F3][F9][F10][RD-5], which yields undetermined (G13). That leaves 1.82 km unresolved and, per the trace, it changes the amount (F3 + F4 = 4.45 km × $1.4101/km = $6.27, against $3.71 if F3 is exempt); I cannot strike 1.82 km as exempt and cannot fix an amount to the cent, so the whole case goes to a person [F3][F4][F5][RD-1][RD-2]. Refunds, if executed, issue as a Ryde voucher [NS-7].

No account flag: the RD-6 screen is ✗ — the driver's 90-day history shows 2 disputes, 1 upheld, with route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, and a profile fact cannot alone support a flag [F18][RD-6]. The remaining billed excess ($7.22 for 5.12 km, F5) and the overall +5.1 km / +11.2 min (F1, F2) are not refundable under RD-2, and the $0.11 metered waiting time for 0.4 min is chargeable on a RydeTAXI trip [F1][F2][F5][F6][F8][RD-2][RD-3].

Safety screen: I read the complaint, both chat messages (F9, F10) and the driver's statement (F12). They concern only a jam-avoidance route question and a GPS reroute; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so safety_concern is "none" [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1].

segment_findings.reason: F10 (14:56, sent before the 14:59 start) agrees to the driver's F9 question proposing to go round via Bukit Batok West Avenue 3 — a named-road agreement under RD-5, not a general route grant; both advocates stipulated named_road_untied. But no record ties the 14:59–15:05 driving to that road: F3 carries no road name, the complete timestamped chat (F11) ends at 14:56, the post-trip driver statement F12 cannot supply the link (G11), and no stop is measured. With nothing tying the segment to the agreed road and nothing placing it elsewhere, the scope is undetermined per RD-5 and G13, not exempt; this changes the amount (1.82 km unresolved), so a person decides.

RD-5 requires a RIDER message sent before the segment start of 15:16 to exempt it. The complete, fully timestamped chat (F11) contains only F9 and F10, both at 14:56, and their words cover only the early stretch via Bukit Batok West Avenue 3 — not a stretch driven 20 minutes later. F12 ('the second turn-off was my GPS rerouting') is a post-trip driver statement and is not rider consent (G11). Both advocates stipulated consent_after_or_none, so F4's 2.63 km extra_km is an unexempted off-route segment under RD-1 and refunds, if the case executes, at 2.63 km × $1.4101/km = $3.71 (rate = $33.56 ÷ 23.80 km) [F4][F5][F8][RD-2].

rejected_claims.reason: RD-6 requires the profile to show route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1 before this case makes the breach repeated; F18 shows 2 disputes, 1 upheld, with route: 0 and no-show: 0, and the trace marks the RD-6 screen ✗. A non-route upheld dispute cannot be substituted, and a profile fact cannot alone decide the point [F18][RD-6].

The driver reaches the right result for the wrong reason: RD-6 is not defeated because the earlier upheld dispute was non-route, but because 'repeated' requires this case to be at least the second upheld instance and F18 shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so this case is the first upheld route breach [F18][RD-6].

The rider asks the court to record F3 as consented under RD-5, but F10 (14:56) answers the driver's F9 question naming a specific road, Bukit Batok West Avenue 3, and no record ties the 14:59–15:05 driving to that road — F3 names no road, F11 shows the chat ends at 14:56, and F12 is a post-trip driver statement that cannot supply the link (G11) [F3][F9][F10][F11][F12][RD-5]. Under RD-5 that is undetermined, not exempt.

The driver's claim that F3 is an agreed named-road detour and therefore not chargeable fails on the same absence of any tie: no stop on Bukit Batok West Avenue 3, no locating message and no road name in any gps fact, so the agreement's scope cannot be confirmed and the segment is undetermined rather than exempt [F3][F9][F10][F11][RD-5]. Reading F10 as a general route grant is refuted by the words of F9/F10, which name a specific road rather than 'whichever way is faster' [F9][F10][RD-5].

The driver asks the court to confine the refund to F4's 2.63 km ($3.71), but the trace marks the F3 scope finding as one that changes the amount; while F3 remains undetermined its 1.82 km cannot be struck, so no fixed total can execute on this record [F3][F4][F5][RD-1][RD-2].
